summary: Penalty per vehicle over max_vehicles at the depot.
businessRules: vehicle_penalty defines: Specify the penalty, a positive integer, for simultaneously servicing vehicles that exceed the max_vehicles limit at any time. This attribute controls the balance between respecting max_vehicles li…
Must stay consistent with: depots.throughput.max_vehicles. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Zero means no penalty/cost; larger values increase incentive to avoid violation.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: higher penalty spreads vehicles across depots/time.
